name: 草头鸭
evolution: 草头鸭 → 卷毛鸭 Lv.40
description: 眼睛长在两侧，不停地转动，不知道是不是在思考，很难解读它的行为规律。视觉范围有360度，从任何方向接近都会被它发现。
descriptionEn: Its eyes are on both sides of its head, constantly turning—hard to tell if it is thinking, and its behavior is difficult to read. With a 360-degree visual range, it will notice any approach from any direction.
